en:
It's just because you look so strong, right?
You can't help but wanna conquer something strong.

If I'm bein' honest...
I'd like to fight you sometime!
Hey, it's not like I enjoy violence.

Sorry Kiryu-san, but that doesn't sound
very convincing coming from you.
Have you ever heard of Pocket Circuit?

Of course I have! When I was little, I used to
play down at the stadium with all the boys.

My best car was a Golem Tiger, and for
my motor, I customized it like this...
Wow! You really know your stuff!

You're a gym rat, Kiryu-san?
Good, if you don't work out, you'll get all weak.

It'd be pretty fun to go on a gym date
with you sometime...<symbol=heart_with_outline>
Yeah, you seem like the quiet type, Kiryu-san.

But don't you ever feel like you
wanna cut loose and get loud?

Not really.
This is my default level.

You serious? I bet you have your
moments where you get amped up.
Well, who can say...

I guess when I'm singing karaoke...
I might get a little carried away.

Awesome! Now this I've gotta see!
Kiryu-san getting into the groove!

Sometimes I might unintentionally,
very subconsciously, get like that.

Huh? You mean that?
I bet you totally do it on purpose.
Maybe just when I'm around you.

Huh? If this is getting loud,
what are you like normally...?

Oh, really? I just assumed
you were the aggressive type.

Well, don't feel like you have to go all
vegetarian with me! I'm a carnivore's delight.
I actually don't warm up to people very easily.

Really? But you're doing just fine with me.
Maybe we're compatible.

Even if it's not a special occasion?
You go every time?
A man likes to show off.

I see... Well if it were me,
I'd put that money to better use.

You seem like the kinda guy that's younger than
he looks... I'll say, 39? How's that?

It's nice to hear it, but unfortunately
I'm well into my 40s.

Really!? You don't look that old at all!
You seem so young and brimming with energy!

You're kinda like a sharp knife.
You look intimidating, but really cool, too.

I think you're a great guy. You look
pretty intimidating, but you're a sweetheart.

Older guys, I guess.
I prefer a man who can take the lead.

I don't think I have any big fetishes!
I make up for it with my fantasies.

What do I want?
A belt, I guess.

A belt?
For your pants?
No no, the wrestling kind.

Of course I want a champion's belt, Kiryu-san...
but yours would be fine...
Hm? Excuse me?

N-Never mind!
I said nothing!

My first love, huh? It was so long ago,
and I was so young. Such bittersweet memories...
What!? You can't ask a girl that!

What a perv, Kiryu-san!
I'm not answering any weird questions!

Marriage, huh?
Well, I dream about it as much as any girl!
What about you?

Me?
Well... maybe someday...
Oh, you're red red red!

Marriage, huh? If I found a guy like you,
I'd jump right in, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I don't really know how to respond when
you put me on the spot like that...

Oh, Kiryu-san! I'm just joking. <symbol=note_with_outline>
No need to get all flustered. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

No one's ever told me that before.
I'm not even that good at it!

Really?
Then maybe you're just naturally beautiful.
Whoa! Kiryu-san, too smooth!
Hey... Have we met somewhere before?
Huh? Have we...?
I might've seen you at a wrestling match.

Oh, that'd make sense.
I suppose it's possible!

I'd be thrilled if you'd seen
one of my matches, Kiryu-san!

Nah, I was overthinking it.
Forget I said anything.

Aw, don't go gettin' my hopes
up like that...
Maybe... we met in a dream.

And now you're a romantic all of a sudden,
Kiryu-san? You're a real strange guy...

Thanks! Maybe it's because I train so much. 
Although I'm worried my abs are starting to show...

Cheating? Well, it certainly
sucks when it happens to you!

Don't tell me...
You're a cheater, Kiryu-san!?
Yes, actually...

Whoa! Putting it right out there, huh!? Well,
Kiryu-san, I'm sure you're popular with the ladies.
I get it! You get a pass this once, Kiryu-san!
O-Oh. Thanks...
No, that's not what I meant.

Really? That's what they all say. A lady's man
like you, Kiryu-san? I'm kinda suspicious...
You're the only one for me.
Wh-What's all this out of the blue, Kiryu-san!?

You're making me all flustered!
You've got a mean sense of humor...

I prefer staying in, I think. I get so much
exercise, I just wanna relax at home when I can.

Oh, you're one of those people, Kiryu-san?
Me too!

Maybe it's because I push myself so hard every
day, but it makes me just want to relax at home.

I'm on the same page!
If we were dating, I'm sure we'd get along. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Yeah, I did. So, pop quiz.
What team was I on?
You're tall, so... volleyball?

Whoa! You got it, Kiryu-san!
I'm impressed.

I heard they scout people based on height.
I'm sure you were the perfect fit.
Aw, thanks.
You're a pro wrestler, so... wrestling?

Nope! Wrong.
Back then I wasn't that into wrestling yet.

I love it now, but the right answer
was the volleyball team.

Volleyball, huh?
You do seem like you'd be a good fit for that.
Were you... not on a team?

Bzzzt! The right answer is... the volleyball team!
I just told I was on a team, didn't I?

But when I was a kid, I kinda lost sight of my
goals... I was just coasting without a plan.

Looking back on it, I have no idea what I was
thinking. I was just a dumb teenager, I guess.
That's life.

What? No way. Laundry sucks.
Wash them yourself, please.

Oh, are you asking me to be your girlfriend?
Whatever should I do...? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

You should save that line for
the girl you want to marry.
Huh? Are you serious?

Huh? A-Are you asking...
If you'll have me... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Oho? Why do you think that?
Most of them can't even speak properly.

Y'know, Kiryu...
It ain't right.
Hey, is that how you really talk?

Joking, joking. <symbol=heart_with_outline> If you can be polite to
strangers, then be polite to your friends.
They just lack conviction.

Oh, I can get on board with that.
I see it a lot in young pro wrestlers.

It's like... they have no passion.
No desire to make it big.

Man, saying all this makes me sound like an
old woman. I gotta watch it.
Looks like we're on the same side.

Hey, you take that back.
I'm still young and lively, I swear!

The girls are really letting themselves go...
Kinda gross.

Oh, is that what you meant?
I was thinking you'd have a lot worse to say!

I sing a lot, but I like the cutesy songs.
They're such a breath of fresh air.

Really? I don't know if I agree.
I like a man who's more calm and collected.

Someone who's kind and open-minded...
with a face like a gorilla!
A gorilla...

He wears an eyepatch and he's half naked under a
weird jacket? Is this Majima-san a pro wrestler?

No, he's a civilian... Well, not exactly.
But, he's strong enough to impress a wrestler.

What!? I really want to meet him now...
I might totally fall for this guy if we met...
Ah, Majima-san...

Hey, what part of anything I just said
makes this guy sound attractive?

A detective, huh? Sounds a little scatterbrained,
but I'm sure he's good guy.

This Akiyama-san is an entrepreneur?
Sounds rich! Ah, you should bring him by!
If I can just get him to request me...

What!?
He took down a bear!?

It's my <font_kind=yakuza_italic>dream</font_kind> as a fighter to take down a bear!
Give me details here!

S-Sure...
Didn't figure that would strike a chord...

You trust him a lot, huh? I'd like
to get to that level with you, Kiryu-san.

I've never been before.
What do you do for fun there, Kiryu-san?

Well...
About all they've got there are bars.

I spend most of the time just chatting with
the bartender, sipping a glass of liquor.

Huh! That sounds like a nice little situation.
I could have some good fantasies about that... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Don't go too crazy.
Kiryu-san. Sorry for the wait.
Kiryu-san! I've been waiting for you.

Sounds good!
I love karaoke.
Darts, huh? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Well, shall we? <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'd like to hear you sing! <symbol=heart_with_outline>

You wanna play against me?
Sure!
All right, let's do this!

Don't let it get you down.
It's all just for fun!

That was fun. <symbol=note_with_outline>
We should come back sometime. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

That was so fun!
We should meet up more often. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Well, let's head back to the club.
Oh, I'm good at this song. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'm feeling good about singing today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
My throat's a little sore...
I-It's hard to sing like that...
You're good at getting me going. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
That was really fun to sing, thanks to you. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Now it's your turn!
Aww... I wanted to hear you sing something.

K-Kiryu-san...
Is this your first time doing karaoke?
You were pretty cool. <symbol=note_with_outline>

You're good, Kiryu-san!
I wish you'd sing to me forever... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Whoa! You're a big spender, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh, I love that. <symbol=note_with_outline>
It's tasty.

Nice to meet you.
I'm Sora, from Taiwan.
Huh. Your Japanese is pretty good.

Thank you. I came here more than ten
years ago, so I've gotten used to it.

My mom's Taiwanese, but my dad's actually half
Japanese. He's the one who taught me the language.

Makes sense. Now that you've said that,
I can see a little Japanese in there.
Um, may I ask what your name is?
Yeah. I'm Kiryu.

Kiryu-san, then.
I look forward to spending time with you today. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Kiryu-san, thanks for coming in today.
Did you have fun?

Wonderful. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Come back anytime. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Welcome back.
I'm so happy to see you again. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Welcome back, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I've been waiting for you... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Kiryu-san, I've been waiting for you... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Let's go for the extended session today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thanks for coming in today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I hope you'll come back again soon.

Kiryu-san. Thanks for coming in today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You'd better come back soon. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Goodbyes are always the hardest...
Come see me again soon, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Oh, Kiryu-san?

This is my phone number. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Text me sometime if you feel like it. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Looks like our time's almost up.
Time truly flies when you're having fun.

Thank you. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Let's keep having fun! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Thanks for coming today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Yes, okay...
That's right. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I know, right?
Okay. If you don't mind. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
No, that's not right.
What!? That's not right at all!
I think that's weird.
No way. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Maybe next time!
That's a secret. <symbol=note_with_outline>

So Kiryu-san, do you have any plans for 
New Year's? Maybe, going overseas?

No, not really.
I'm not really the type to travel overseas.

What about you, Sora?
Do you go every year?

I go a lot, but in my case, it's less of a
vacation and more going home to visit family.

Oh, right.
You're from Taiwan.

Yep! I've loved my family my whole life. Even
now I get the urge to go see them all the time.

What about you, Kiryu-san?
Do you like your family?
Of course I do.

You too, huh? I'm glad.
Family's great, right?
Yeah, you're right.
(Family, huh?)

(All those days I spent with Kazama-san and
Nishiki... Thinking about it takes me back.)
Kiryu-san...? What's wrong?

Nothing, just lost in thought.
Sora, you take care of your family, okay?

The time you have with them is finite,
so don't ever forget how irreplaceable they are.

Yeah... You're exactly right. I want to keep
working hard to do my part for my parents!
I... never knew my parents.

Huh? O-Oh...
I... I'm sorry.

No, it's okay. Don't worry about it.
It doesn't really bother me.

Besides, even though I never knew my parents,
I've met so many people I'm proud to call family.
They mean more to me than any blood ever could.

I see. I think you're very lucky to have so many
people you'd consider close enough to be family.

Yeah. I hope you make lots of bonds like that too,
and that goes for your whole family.

Yeah! It would be nice if the two
of us could become like family, huh?
